quick_replies.title: Location & parking
quick_replies.body: We're at 12 Carter Road, Bandra West — next to Café Sol. There's free parking in the lane behind the studio, and paid parking at Joggers Park.

quick_replies.title: Opening hours
quick_replies.body: We're open Monday to Friday 9 AM–7 PM, and Saturday 9 AM–5 PM. Closed on Sundays.

quick_replies.title: What to bring
quick_replies.body: Nothing special! For colour appointments please come with dry, unwashed hair. Arriving 5 minutes early helps.

quick_replies.title: Running late?
quick_replies.body: No problem — let us know roughly when you'll arrive. If it's more than 15 minutes we may need to move you to a later slot.

quick_replies.title: Prices
quick_replies.body: Haircut & style ₹1,200 · Hair colour from ₹3,800 · Facial ₹2,800 · Massage ₹2,500 · Manicure ₹900. Want me to check a time for you?

quick_replies.title: Payments
quick_replies.body: We accept UPI, all major cards and cash. Members get 10% off automatically.
